pages.text: A Bag adds $(thing)352 storage capacity$() in a Hip slot. Each equipped Bag adds 15% exhaustion from sprinting, jumping, and swimming. That makes these actions drain saturation or hunger sooner. Normal walking and natural regeneration keep their usual cost.
Use one string and four Pouches. The input Pouches can be different colors.

pages.title: Multiple Bags
pages.text: The movement penalty adds per Bag. One gives +15%, two give +30%, and three give +45%. Three Bags add 1,056 capacity before any Echo Rings.$(br2)Bags are rarer than Pouches in chests. Look in Nether and End structures for better odds.
